contract.title: Wave A: ranking-policy-artifact.ts residual/descriptor/final-artifact parsers and canonicalizers
contract.invariant: Parsers distinguish ResidualModelV1, FoldContenderDescriptorV1, and RankingPolicyV3Artifact independently; final-artifact provider fields bind the sealed R1.2 request contract and R1.4 activation contract; canonical bytes round-trip; no self-hash, no quality receipt.
production_callers: (no base runtime caller; Wave D/E consumers per §7.2: D2/D3 train+verify, D7 application library, D8 final-artifact builder, E4 serialization)
interface_changes: packages/mcp/src/core/ranking-policy-artifact.ts (new file; exact-key parsers/canonicalizers for ResidualModelV1 (ranking_residual_model_v1), FoldContenderDescriptorV1 (ranking_fold_contender_v1), RankingPolicyV3Artifact (ranking_policy_v3, policyId search_ranking_policy_v3) per §5.3)
security_boundaries: Final artifact contains no self-hash and no quality receipt; runtime SHA-256 is computed over canonical bytes; provider_derived mode must exactly match the sealed fixed target plus the separately sealed R1.2 request-contract digest; disabled mode carries no provider fields (§5.3)
overlap_with: D2/D3/D5/D7/D8 (Waves D/E): all require A5 (exact prerequisite table)
B7 (Wave B): replay v3 requires A5 and A6
R1.2 (training/request contract) and R1.4 (artifact/activation contract) are the sealed field authorities
contract.instructions: Create packages/mcp/src/core/ranking-policy-artifact.ts (new file) with exact-key parsers and canonicalizers for all three §5.3 forms: ResidualModelV1, FoldContenderDescriptorV1 (mode disabled | provider_derived), RankingPolicyV3Artifact (schemaVersion ranking_policy_v3, policyId search_ranking_policy_v3, featureSchema search_features_v1, normalization NormalizationContractV1 with missingValuePolicy indicator_zero_fill). §7.6 A5 RED row: test 'distinguishes_residual_descriptor_and_final_artifact_and_binds_r1_2_fields'; expected failure: parser conflates forms or ignores request/gate fields; minimal passing: each form parses independently and final provider fields match R1.2. Artifact has no self-hash and no quality receipt; SHA-256 over canonical bytes. Disabled mode has no provider fields even when binding a fixed provider target digest for provenance. Focused command is plan-specified (§7.5 A5 row) and targets a test file absent at round_base: unverifiable-at-base. Affected command pnpm --filter @zokizuan/satori-mcp test is repo-verified and must pass.
